31	def atomic_write_json(path: Path, payload: Any) -> None:
32	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
33	    # Unique tmp per writer — several workers refresh inventory/summary in parallel.
34	    tmp_path = path.with_name(f"{path.name}.{os.getpid()}.{utcnow().timestamp():.0f}.tmp")
35	    try:
36	        tmp_path.write_text(
37	            json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str),
38	            encoding="utf-8",
39	        )
40	        os.replace(tmp_path, path)
41	    finally:
42	        try:
43	            tmp_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
44	        except OSError:
45	            pass

70	def file_lock(path: Path) -> Iterator[None]:
71	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
72	    fd = os.open(str(path), os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY)
73	    try:
74	        os.write(fd, str(os.getpid()).encode("utf-8"))
75	        yield
76	    finally:
77	        os.close(fd)
78	        try:
79	            path.unlink()
80	        except FileNotFoundError:
81	            pass

446	    def append_enrich_record(self, *, category: str, video_id: str, payload: dict) -> Path:
447	        pending = self._pending_enrich.setdefault(category, [])
448	        pending.append({"video_id": video_id, "payload": payload})
449	        base = self.shards_dir / "enrich" / f"category={category}"
450	        pending_path = base / "part_pending.json"
451	        existing: dict[str, dict] = {}
452	        if pending_path.exists():
453	            try:
454	                raw = json.loads(pending_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
455	                if isinstance(raw, dict):
456	                    existing = raw
457	            except json.JSONDecodeError:
458	                existing = {}
459	        existing[video_id] = payload
460	        atomic_write_json(pending_path, existing)
461	        batch_size = max(1, min(self.config.hf_enrich_upload_batch_files, self.config.shard_size))
462	        if len(existing) >= batch_size:
463	            return self.flush_enrich_pending(category, force=True)
464	        return pending_path

466	    def flush_enrich_pending(self, category: str, *, force: bool = False) -> Path:
467	        pending = self._pending_enrich.get(category, [])
468	        base = self.shards_dir / "enrich" / f"category={category}"
469	        pending_path = base / "part_pending.json"
470	        if pending_path.exists():
471	            try:
472	                raw = json.loads(pending_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
473	            except json.JSONDecodeError:
474	                raw = {}
475	            if isinstance(raw, dict):
476	                known = {item["video_id"] for item in pending}
477	                pending.extend(
478	                    {"video_id": video_id, "payload": payload}
479	                    for video_id, payload in raw.items()
480	                    if video_id not in known
481	                )
482	        if not pending and not force:
483	            raise ValueError("cannot write empty enrich shard")
484	        chunk = pending[: self.config.shard_size] if not force else list(pending)
485	        del pending[: len(chunk)]
486	        if not chunk:
487	            raise ValueError("cannot write empty enrich shard")
488	        shard_path = base / f"part_{self._next_index(base):06d}.json"
489	        atomic_write_json(shard_path, {item["video_id"]: item["payload"] for item in chunk})
490	        pending_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
491	        for item in chunk:
492	            relpath = str(shard_path.relative_to(self.root))
493	            self.enqueue_hf_enrich_upload(
494	                platform="youtube",
495	                video_id=item["video_id"],
496	                category=category,
497	                local_path=relpath,
498	            )
499	            self.mark_metadata_enrich_done(
500	                f"youtube:{item['video_id']}",
501	                video_id=item["video_id"],
502	                shard=relpath,
503	            )
504	        return shard_path

506	    def flush_all_enrich_pending(self) -> list[Path]:
507	        written: list[Path] = []
508	        categories = set(self._pending_enrich.keys())
509	        enrich_root = self.shards_dir / "enrich"
510	        if enrich_root.exists():
511	            categories.update(
512	                path.parent.name.replace("category=", "")
513	                for path in enrich_root.glob("category=*/part_pending.json")
514	            )
515	        for category in sorted(categories):
516	            pending = self._pending_enrich.get(category, [])
517	            pending_path = self.shards_dir / "enrich" / f"category={category}" / "part_pending.json"
518	            if pending or pending_path.exists():
519	                written.append(self.flush_enrich_pending(category, force=True))
520	        return written

126	def wait_for_commit_slot(
127	    *,
128	    state_dir: Path,
129	    repo_id: str,
130	    min_interval_seconds: int,
131	    hourly_limit: int = 100,
132	) -> None:
133	    """Throttle commits per HF repo using both min interval and rolling-hour cap."""
134	    if min_interval_seconds <= 0 and hourly_limit <= 0:
135	        return
136	    log_path = state_dir / "hf_commit_log.jsonl"
137	    last_ts: float | None = None
138	    recent: list[float] = []
139	    now = time.time()
140	    if log_path.exists():
141	        for line in log_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
142	            if not line.strip():
143	                continue
144	            try:
145	                row = json.loads(line)
146	            except json.JSONDecodeError:
147	                continue
148	            if row.get("repo_id") == repo_id:
149	                ts = float(row.get("ts") or 0)
150	                last_ts = ts
151	                if ts > now - 3600:
152	                    recent.append(ts)
153	    if last_ts:
154	        wait = min_interval_seconds - (now - last_ts)
155	        if wait > 0:
156	            time.sleep(wait)
157	            now = time.time()
158	    if hourly_limit > 0:
159	        recent = sorted(ts for ts in recent if ts > now - 3600)
160	        if len(recent) >= hourly_limit:
161	            wait = 3600 - (now - recent[0]) + 1
162	            if wait > 0:
163	                time.sleep(wait)

178	        if error is not None and not is_proxy_transport_error(error):
179	            return
180	        self._blacklist.add(normalized)
181	        reason = type(error).__name__ if error is not None else "transport_error"
182	        self._on_blacklist(normalized, reason)
183	        if self._last_good == normalized:
184	            self._last_good = None

186	    def record_download_failure(self, proxy: str | None) -> None:
187	        """Blacklist proxy after a failed pytubefix/yt-dlp download attempt."""
188	        if not proxy:
189	            return
190	        normalized = normalize_proxy_url(proxy)
191	        self._blacklist.add(normalized)
192	        self._on_blacklist(normalized, "download_failed")
193	        if self._last_good == normalized:
194	            self._last_good = None
195	
196	    def _available_proxies(self) -> list[str]:
197	        available = [proxy for proxy in self.proxies if proxy not in self._blacklist]
198	        if available:
199	            return available
200	        if self._blacklist:
201	            print(
202	                "[proxy] all proxies blacklisted, resetting blacklist",
203	                file=sys.stderr,
204	                flush=True,
205	            )
206	            self._blacklist.clear()
207	        return list(self.proxies)
208	
209	    def next(self) -> Optional[str]:
210	        available = self._available_proxies()
211	        if not available:
212	            return None
213	        if self._last_good and self._last_good in available:
214	            return self._last_good
215	        if self._iterator is None:
216	            self._iterator = cycle(self.proxies)
217	        for _ in range(len(self.proxies)):
218	            candidate = normalize_proxy_url(next(self._iterator))
219	            if candidate in available:
220	                return candidate
221	        return available[0]

97	def load_youtube_keys(path: str | None) -> list[str]:
98	    if path:
99	        keys_path = Path(path)
100	        raw = keys_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
101	        if keys_path.suffix.lower() == ".json":
102	            data = json.loads(raw)
103	            if isinstance(data, list):
104	                return [str(item) for item in data if item]
105	            return [str(item) for item in data.get("keys", []) if item]
106	        keys = []
107	        for line in raw.splitlines():
108	            line = line.strip()
109	            if not line or line.startswith("#"):
110	                continue
111	            keys.extend([token.strip() for token in line.replace(",", " ").split() if token.strip()])
112	        return list(dict.fromkeys(keys))
113	    env_value = os.getenv("FETCHER_YOUTUBE_DATA_API_KEYS") or os.getenv("FETCHER_YOUTUBE_DATA_API_KEY")
114	    return [item.strip() for item in (env_value or "").split(",") if item.strip()]

199	    next_due: datetime | None = None

229	    verbose: bool = True,
230	) -> dict[str, int]:
231	    """Collect follow-up snapshots per video when each video's due_at elapses (never early)."""
232	    indices = snapshot_follow_up_indices(config)
233	    totals = {"snapshots": 0, "passes": 0}
234	    if not indices:
235	        if verbose:

240	    if verbose:

242	        log_snapshot_poll_report(snapshot_poll_report(state, config, now=runner._now()))
243	
244	    while pending_snapshot_indices(state, indices):
245	        totals["passes"] += 1
246	        collected_this_pass = 0
247	        for index in indices:

249	            if not due:

252	            n = len(result)

254	            totals["snapshots"] += n

257	                done = _done_count_for_index(report, index)

260	                    f"(готово {done}/{schedule_size})",
261	                    flush=True,
262	                )
263	
264	        if not pending_snapshot_indices(state, indices):
265	            break
266	
267	        wait_sec = seconds_until_next_snapshot_due(state, indices, now=runner._now())
268	        if wait_sec is None:

270	        if wait_sec > 0:

276	                    flush=True,

446	    def append_enrich_record(self, *, category: str, video_id: str, payload: dict) -> Path:
447	        pending = self._pending_enrich.setdefault(category, [])
448	        pending.append({"video_id": video_id, "payload": payload})
449	        base = self.shards_dir / "enrich" / f"category={category}"
450	        pending_path = base / "part_pending.json"
451	        existing: dict[str, dict] = {}
452	        if pending_path.exists():
453	            try:
454	                raw = json.loads(pending_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
455	                if isinstance(raw, dict):
456	                    existing = raw
457	            except json.JSONDecodeError:
458	                existing = {}
459	        existing[video_id] = payload
460	        atomic_write_json(pending_path, existing)
461	        batch_size = max(1, min(self.config.hf_enrich_upload_batch_files, self.config.shard_size))
462	        if len(existing) >= batch_size:
463	            return self.flush_enrich_pending(category, force=True)
464	        return pending_path
465	
466	    def flush_enrich_pending(self, category: str, *, force: bool = False) -> Path:
467	        pending = self._pending_enrich.get(category, [])
468	        base = self.shards_dir / "enrich" / f"category={category}"
469	        pending_path = base / "part_pending.json"
470	        if pending_path.exists():
471	            try:
472	                raw = json.loads(pending_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
473	            except json.JSONDecodeError:
474	                raw = {}
475	            if isinstance(raw, dict):
476	                known = {item["video_id"] for item in pending}
477	                pending.extend(
478	                    {"video_id": video_id, "payload": payload}
479	                    for video_id, payload in raw.items()
480	                    if video_id not in known
481	                )
482	        if not pending and not force:
483	            raise ValueError("cannot write empty enrich shard")
484	        chunk = pending[: self.config.shard_size] if not force else list(pending)
485	        del pending[: len(chunk)]
486	        if not chunk:
487	            raise ValueError("cannot write empty enrich shard")
488	        shard_path = base / f"part_{self._next_index(base):06d}.json"
489	        atomic_write_json(shard_path, {item["video_id"]: item["payload"] for item in chunk})
490	        pending_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
491	        for item in chunk:
492	            relpath = str(shard_path.relative_to(self.root))
493	            self.enqueue_hf_enrich_upload(
494	                platform="youtube",
495	                video_id=item["video_id"],
496	                category=category,
497	                local_path=relpath,
498	            )
499	            self.mark_metadata_enrich_done(
500	                f"youtube:{item['video_id']}",
501	                video_id=item["video_id"],
502	                shard=relpath,
503	            )
504	        return shard_path
505	
506	    def flush_all_enrich_pending(self) -> list[Path]:
507	        written: list[Path] = []
508	        categories = set(self._pending_enrich.keys())
509	        enrich_root = self.shards_dir / "enrich"
510	        if enrich_root.exists():
511	            categories.update(
512	                path.parent.name.replace("category=", "")
513	                for path in enrich_root.glob("category=*/part_pending.json")
514	            )
515	        for category in sorted(categories):
516	            pending = self._pending_enrich.get(category, [])
517	            pending_path = self.shards_dir / "enrich" / f"category={category}" / "part_pending.json"
518	            if pending or pending_path.exists():
519	                written.append(self.flush_enrich_pending(category, force=True))
520	        return written

180	    video = None
181	    for stream in yt.streams.filter(adaptive=True, only_video=True).order_by("resolution").desc():
182	        height = _parse_resolution_height(stream.resolution)
183	        if height > max_height:
184	            continue

188	    if video is None:

190	            if _parse_resolution_height(stream.resolution) <= max_height:
191	                video = stream

260	    yt: YouTube,
261	    *,
262	    target: Path,
263	    max_height: int,
264	    log: Callable[[str], None],
265	) -> str:
266	    """Download best mp4 up to max_height; ffmpeg-merge adaptive when higher than progressive."""
267	    progressive = _pick_progressive_stream(yt, max_height)
268	    progressive_height = _parse_resolution_height(progressive.resolution if progressive else None)
269	
270	    video_stream, audio_stream = _pick_adaptive_streams(yt, max_height=max_height)
271	    adaptive_height = _parse_resolution_height(video_stream.resolution if video_stream else None)
272	
273	    if video_stream and audio_stream and adaptive_height > progressive_height:
274	        tmp_video = target.with_name(f"{target.stem}.video.tmp")
275	        tmp_audio = target.with_name(f"{target.stem}.audio.tmp")
276	        log(
277	            f"  adaptive {video_stream.resolution} + {audio_stream.abr} "
278	            f"({video_stream.filesize_mb:.1f}+{audio_stream.filesize_mb:.1f} MiB) -> ffmpeg merge"
279	        )
280	        try:
281	            video_stream.download(output_path=str(target.parent), filename=tmp_video.name)
282	            _check_shutdown()
283	            audio_stream.download(output_path=str(target.parent), filename=tmp_audio.name)
284	            _check_shutdown()

290

293

246	        self,
247	        field_name: str,
248	        value: str,
249	        field_config: BalancerFieldConfig,

251	        counts = self.counts.setdefault(field_name, Counter())
252	        total = sum(counts.values())

254	        if total <= 0:

258	            cap = field_config.unknown_max_share

263	            return 1.0

266	        projected_share = (current + 1) / (total + 1)
267	        if projected_share <= target:

269	        return min(1.0, (projected_share - target) / max(target, 0.001))

def _chunked_sleep(total_seconds: float, *, chunk: float = 3600.0) -> None:
    """Sleep total_seconds in chunks so long waits survive Colab inactivity checks."""
    remaining = total_seconds
    while remaining > 0:
        time.sleep(min(remaining, chunk))
        remaining -= chunk
